text:
Sampled-candidate metrics can reverse model rankings relative to full-catalog evaluation, even in expectation; fixing negative candidates improves comparability but does not remove sampling bias ([Krichene and Rendle](https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/651)). Recent work continues examining sampling reliability ([RecSys 2025](https://doi.org/10.1145/3705328.3748086)); a 2024 study develops improved rank estimates for negative-sampling-based learning ([Subbiah et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06371)). Implication: retain the pinned 99-negative macro HR@10 for selection; separately measure sampled/full-catalog model-order agreement on validation users using rank correlation and pairwise winner agreement. Full-catalog diagnostics must exclude seen items and use validation targets only.

Recommended calibration: compare the matched SASRec backbone, last-item control, and uniform-pooling control under identical splits, seeds, candidates, and training budgets. Bootstrap paired per-user hit differences within each category, then average the four category differences equally; report the observed change and 95% interval. Such intervals condition on the trained models and fixed candidate sets; they do not capture training randomness or repeated-search selection bias. Research supports reporting effect sizes and uncertainty alongside significance ([Ihemelandu and Ekstrand](https://piret.info/pubs/2023/SIGIR23-InferenceAtScale)). Report counts and paired changes by training-history length and target-item training popularity; aggregate accuracy can conceal popularity-related disparities ([2024 survey](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11257-024-09406-0)).

Treat diagnostic probes as hypothesis generators until their changes predict validation gains across these controls. Feedback concerning twenty training users—five per category—is exploratory: report individual outcomes and denominators, acknowledge selection and simulator uncertainty, and avoid population-level satisfaction claims. Diversity/conformity traits remain unobserved; qualitative feedback cannot establish them.
